title: PPO net2 on net1 v5, search stage 1: discount horizon by exploration
description: Recurrent PPO for net2 (src/expliccit_env/train/ppo.py) on the frozen net1 v5 (exp-net1v4-recheck-79), from a clone of its fixed rule (u = 0.25, exp-rule-net1v5-val-82), on examples/net1_broad.py's net2-train links with competition over-weighted. Stage 1 of the search on validation: tau (the discount's time constant) in 1, 3 and 10 s by exploration sigma (log2 of the window) in 0.05, 0.1 and 0.2, at learning rate 3e-4, K = 4 rollouts per link, 8 links per iteration, 40 iterations, 3 critic-only iterations first. Each cell is evaluated noise-free every 10 iterations and at its start on the validation links' new-conditions family and paired by link with the rule; the stage keeps the cell with the best last evaluation, and stage 2 varies the learning rate and K around it. Validation links only.
run: S="$OUT/spec-t$TAU-s$SIGMA.json"; jq --argjson t "$TAU" --argjson s "$SIGMA" '.tau_s = $t | .noise_sigma = $s | .iterations = 40 | .eval_every = 10' "$OUT/setup/ppo-base.json" > "$S"; uv run expliccit train ppo "$S" "$OUT/ppo-t$TAU-s$SIGMA" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS"
